description: A bare method name is not an object identity. Node Hash, Hmac, Cipheriv and Decipheriv objects all expose update because they stream bytes; an ORM model exposes update because it changes a shared record. The four clean crypto calls exercise both chained and assigned receiver provenance, including the two shapes that produced false CWE-639 findings in umami. The expected ORM finding holds recall: the record-selector channel still recognizes update everywhere except receivers structurally proven to come from one of the four crypto constructors.

expected.note: the receiver came from an application model rather than a crypto constructor, so update remains a record-selector operation
